title: Write the checks that catch a lost hold

cases.says: the checks pass for a HoldFunds that answers every purchase and leaves each card with the right balance
the checks fail for a HoldFunds that votes NO_JOIN after holding the money, so the real TransactionManager never gives it back when the issuer declines
the checks fail for a HoldFunds whose own refusal joins and whose abort credits an amount it never held
the checks fail for a HoldFunds that refuses without leaving a response, because the terminal then gets nothing

origin.section: 11.2 Only the Real TransactionManager Decides Who Hears the Outcome
